messages:
maya: Quick sync request — we need a concise playbook for when we retire a model variant and swap customers to a replacement.
sam: Agree. Customers are asking for notice windows + measurable rollback gates. Can we make a small rubric?
eli: From eval side: require: (1) >=0.5% absolute improvement on primary eval OR no more than 1% regression across critical prompts, (2) lat median within 10% of current, (3) p95 <= existing p95 + 50ms.
maya: That’s concrete. Add customer-impact checks: downstream rerank changes, embeddings drift, business-critical prompts flagged.
frank: For customer comms we need: migration window, opt-out mechanism, and a temporary endpoint pin for 30 days. Also list of affected customers.
jordan: Ops asks for rollout gates: canary at 1% traffic -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated health checks and automatic rollback on error-rate spike or latency breach.
sam: Health checks we can codify as: error_rate > 0.5% absolute, latency p95 > threshold, and quality regression on sentinel prompts. We should surface these metrics in console per-route.
eli: For the sentinel prompts, we should require a small suite (10-20) per domain. Thresholds should be acceptance criteria per product area.
maya: Proposed launch checklist (short):
- Eval pass (eli)
- Perf pass (sam/jordan)
- Customer impact review (frank)
- Docs & comms ready (maya)
- Migration runbook + opt-out (frank)
- Canary config + auto-rollback (sam)
frank: Who owns the opt-out endpoint? We need a PM or CE to approve list and legal signoff for data retention during trial.
maya: I'll own PM signoff. Frank + CE to prepare list. Legal looped if enterprise customers affected.
jordan: Add infra constraint: if model variant requires quantization or different GPU class, must include fallback to compatible variant with graceful degradation.
sam: And add separate billing note: migrations that change per-token cost require billing notice 30 days before full cutover.
eli: For deprecation timing: propose staged deprecation notifications: 60 days (heads-up), 30 days (migration plan), 7 days (final), then sunset with named rollback plan kept for 90 days.
maya: Good. Can we embed a short snippet for the runbook to be used in alerts?
```
if health.check.failed or quality.regression > 1%:
  rollback_to(previous_stable)
  notify(#product, @oncall)
  open incident ticket with tags: model-migration, auto-rollback
```
frank: Looks good. Also include a customer-facing KB template for migration steps + how to pin to old variant.
sam: Action items:
- eli: finalize eval thresholds and sentinel prompt lists by EOD Tue
- sam: draft canary config + auto-rollback playbook by Wed
- frank: draft customer comms + opt-out endpoint by Wed
- maya: coordinate legal + finalize migration notification cadence
- jordan: confirm infra fallback and latency SLAs

maya: Thanks. If nobody objects I’ll add this to the product initiative doc and link the runbook in the console as a standard migration template. :+1:
catalyst-bot: Reminder: add task checkboxes to the initiative ticket (RD-824)
eli: Minor Q — for embeddings-heavy customers, do we require additional semantic-drift checks or is sentinel prompts enough?
frank: Add a tag for embeddings: require drift test on sample corpus with cosine threshold (suggest 0.03) as a pre-deploy gate.
maya: Noted. We'll keep the doc minimal but include embeddings addendum. I'll post the draft in #product-docs once I incorporate thresholds.
